انطبعوا (form VII)
# اِنْطَبَعُوا (inṭabaʕū) /in.tˤa.ba.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# اِنْطَبِعُوا (inṭabiʕū) /in.tˤa.bi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
